decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing the Hero V right arm as exclusive to the Hero V and É accent and the left arm as the design philosophy for the remaining letters.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY prohibiting the expressive right-arm gesture in the E and L and replacing it with the Hero V left arm's restrained architectural philosophy.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that restricts the expressive signature terminal to the Hero V and É accent, updates its evaluation rule, and narrows its scope contexts accordingly.
The source preserves the É accent's existing literal derivation from the Hero V right-arm terminal; it does not alter the candidate's current derivation or geometry-match requirements.
Restricting the expressive right-arm language to the Hero V and É accent does not change their existing exact peak-alignment requirement.
The source changes the second V's gesture derivation but does not change its established height hierarchy or quiet subordinate role.
The source decision concerns glyph design language and does not change the wordmark's kerning, spacing, rhythm, or unified-reading requirement.
The source provides design feedback but does not change the requirement to explain design intentions and their translation into rendered letterforms.
The source addresses letterform geometry and architectural language, not the deferred champagne material treatment or its role.
The source has no effect on acceptable proof attachment formats or Mac viewability.
